review.tagline: Self-hosted AI tutor with knowledge bases, guided learning, books and quizzes
review.summary: DeepTutor is a Python backend with a Next.js 16 web UI for studying from your own documents. It combines chat over knowledge bases (LightRAG, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LlamaIndex, FAISS) with guided learning, generated books, quizzes, question banks and deep research. It also offers multi-user accounts, IM-connected Partners, MCP services and a CLI.
review.audience: Students and educators self-hosting a document-grounded AI tutor
strengths: Several retrieval engines selectable per knowledge base: LightRAG, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LlamaIndex
Covers study workflows: guided learning, mastery gates, quizzes, question bank, daily practice
Multi-user deployment with per-user isolation, admin grants and learner/guardian accounts
Wide provider and parser coverage, including Codex OAuth, MinerU, Tika and PyMuPDF4LLM
weaknesses: Fast release cadence with breaking refactors (v1.6.3) makes upgrades risky
Large surface area: Partners, MCP, CLI apps and plugins add configuration overhead
RAM, GPU and port requirements are not stated in the visible README
Aimed at learning and study; less suited to general chat or enterprise search
needs: Models: OpenAI-compatible providers, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI Codex OAuth, Lemonade (local)
